answer: Let G=(V,E) have a normalized Laplacian cut gap lambda_2>0 separating honest V_h from adversarial V_a. Personalized EigenTrust iterates x_{t+1}=P^T x_t then decay to a limit whose V_a mass is O(rho^t), rho<1.
